args.query: pandas 3.0 copy-on-write: chained assignment no longer updates the DataFrame, and the new default string dtype

results.title: pandas to_sql and read_sql with a SQLAlchemy 2 engine on sqlite, with dtype handling
results.summary: Write and read DataFrames through a SQLAlchemy 2 engine, control column types with dtype, and handle datetimes and nullable ints, tested offline on in-memory sqlite.

results.title: pandas DataFrame to formatted Excel report with openpyxl styles and roundtrip read
results.summary: Write a DataFrame to a styled .xlsx with openpyxl (header styles, number formats, widths, freeze panes, filters), then read it back with pandas and verify, fully offline.

results.title: pandas + Pandera DataFrame schema validation
results.summary: Validate pandas DataFrames with Pandera DataFrameModel schemas: dtypes, coercion, value checks, custom dataframe checks and lazy error reports.

results.title: scikit-learn Pipeline with ColumnTransformer on pandas, GridSearchCV and joblib
results.summary: A scikit-learn Pipeline that scales numeric columns and one-hot encodes categories inside a ColumnTransformer on a pandas DataFrame, tuned with GridSearchCV, then saved and reloaded with joblib. Tested offline on small in-memory data.

results.title: Pandas pyarrow-backed dtypes with partitioned Parquet round trips
results.summary: Write and read partitioned Parquet with pyarrow, enforce a pa.schema on write, and keep nullable ints intact using dtype_backend=pyarrow, tested offline on tmp_path.

results.title: rapidfuzz extractOne and scorers for fuzzy string matching
results.summary: Pick the best candidate with process.extractOne, control matching with WRatio, partial and token scorers, and normalize messy input with utils.default_process.

results.title: string width and ansi stripping
results.summary: Measure the visual width of ASCII, CJK, and emoji strings and strip ANSI escape codes with string-width and strip-ansi, asserting widths and cleaned output offline.

results.title: fs-extra json roundtrip, copy and move
results.summary: Build a temp tree with fs-extra ensureDir, writeJson/readJson, copy, move, pathExists and remove, asserting JSON roundtrip and updated paths offline.

results.title: magic-string sourcemap edits
results.summary: Overwrite, prependLeft, append and remove ranges in a source string with magic-string, generate a hires source map and verify positions with source-map-js SourceMapConsumer.originalPositionFor offline.

results.title: preact render to string SSR
results.summary: Server-render preact components with preact-render-to-string, covering props, useState initial values, conditional output, keyed lists and dangerouslySetInnerHTML while asserting exact escaped HTML offline.
